data.name: Hujjatun
data.gender_notes: Hujjatun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of divine guidance and truth, derived from the Arabic root 'hujj' meaning 'to support' and 'to prove'. It carries the connotation of being a bearer of truth and a source of guidance. In the Quran, Allah says, 'And We sent not before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke, the unbelievers said: 'A sorcerer! A poet! And thus they rejected the Signs of Allah, and We pardoned them. And We have sent thee a clear Sign from Allah.' (Quran 26:26)

in_arabic.name: حجت
in_arabic.meaning: الحجة المطلقة، دليل قاطع، إثبات قاطع
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحجة المطلقة هي دليل قاطع يقدم أدلة لا لبس فيها، يقدم إثباتًا مطلقًا، لا يدع مجالًا للشك أو الجدل. الحجة المطلقة في الإسلام تعني دليل قاطع على صحة الدين أو على صحة بعض الأمور. يُستخدم هذا المصطلح في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة، آية 147، حيث يُكتب (وَمَن يُرِدِ اللَّهُ فَمَن يُضِلْ وَيُضِلُ اللَّهُ مَن يُرِيدهُ)، ويُفسّر هنا بأن الحجة المطلقة هي دليل الله الذي لا يُستطاع منعه، وهو دليل قاطع على صحة الدين.

in_english.name: Hujjatun
in_english.meaning: Ultimate evidence, conclusive proof, irrefutable argument
in_english.long_meaning: Hujjatun refers to the ultimate evidence or conclusive proof that establishes a fact or a truth beyond any doubt. In Islamic tradition, this term is used to describe a proof that is so strong and convincing that it cannot be refuted. It is often associated with the concept of Tawhid, or the oneness of God, and is considered a fundamental principle of Islamic theology.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hujjatun (fervently believed in Arabic languages as Hojatol Islam) holds special significance in Islamic culture as it was the title given to a revered religious scholar named Imam Hossein ibn Ali, who is considered a central figure in Shia Islam and the Karbala legend. The name represents the notion of being a Proof of God, a guardian of truth for the masses, the coat of arms of faith, and a beacon of light for the lost. Historically, numerous highly esteemed religious leaders in the Islamic world have been given the names Hujjat or Hujjatun, emphasizing their role in leading the people towards truth and righteousness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hujjatun is a profound reminder of the divine guidance and truth that individuals seek in their lives. It connects deeply with the spiritual essence of anointed individuals, enjoining them with their sacred duty to lead others towards the truth lovingly and unwaveringly. The name Hujjatun honors its bearer as a talented expositor of the teachings of Allah and the Quran, someone holding a deep understanding of religious principles and a fearless explicator of the same. It symbolizes a sacred duty, a continuous quest for knowledge and understanding, and the commitment to use that knowledge to guide others towards the righteous path. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Hujjatun affirms the essence of the connection between the creators and the created, emphasizing faith, reflection, and the eternal pursuit of knowledge.
